implemented_boundary.private_database_transport: Only SOCIAL_ARCHIVE_PRIVATE_DB_CLIENT may invoke the official KMOS private_db_client.py ingest/verify API. Missing, unreadable, or wrongly named clients stop before RuntimeStore initialization. The implementation never calls git clone, git add, git commit, git pull, git push, or a local Private-Database checkout.
implemented_boundary.completed_fact_gate: RuntimeStore exports a fact only when its content has at least one artifact and every artifact is already status=complete. That status remains governed by the existing identical R2/OCI/GitHub ciphertext receipt gate.
implemented_boundary.fact_integrity_and_idempotency: A deterministic credential-safe fact excludes local_path, removes sensitive metadata keys and URL query keys, redacts inline credential patterns, uses a canonical JSON byte representation, and uses that exact SHA-256 as the Outbox identity and API ingest batch. A delivered event is never resent unless a current fact changes.
implemented_boundary.remote_ack_gate: After ingest, the wrapper calls official verify and requires a parseable Private-MetaDatabase summary with total>0, missing=0, and total=present. The official client can print missing objects while exiting zero, so an unparseable or incomplete summary leaves all affected facts pending rather than claiming delivery.
implemented_boundary.cold_backup_gate: backup.py accepts only current facts whose exact matching Outbox event is delivered. It builds the recovery tar from temporary API-synchronized fact files, encrypts it once with age, uploads and reads back R2 first, then uses the same ciphertext for OCI. R2 failure blocks OCI; either missing receipt yields DEGRADED, never PASS.
implemented_boundary.local_checkout_removal: Settings no longer creates the legacy private_database_root. Compose, .env.example, install.sh, and systemd no longer mount/install/write a Private-Database working tree. The timer uses bounded --once sync and the backup service has no write access to /opt/social-archive/runtime.

fixture_coverage.no_local_checkout: Missing API client and missing age recipient each return BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT before a new data root or legacy private path exists; compose/install/systemd contracts reject mounting or creating that path.
fixture_coverage.safe_fact: A fully three-replica-complete capture with token-bearing metadata, URL query, body, and local artifact path is serialized without those sensitive/raw-local values.
fixture_coverage.idempotency: The first fake official-client pass invokes ingest then a complete verify summary and marks the exact Outbox payload delivered; a second pass is NO_CHANGE with zero client calls.
fixture_coverage.verification_failure: A nonzero verify and a misleading zero-exit verify summary with missing objects both keep the fact pending and return DEGRADED.
fixture_coverage.cold_backup: Only delivered current facts enter the temporary recovery bundle. Fake R2 then OCI receipts prove the same encrypted ciphertext/key is used; R2 failure prevents an OCI attempt. The S3 receipt test binds original SHA-256, cipher SHA-256, algorithm, and readback hash.

semantic_reconciliation.reason: The frozen sync overlay clones, edits, commits, rebases, and pushes a local Private-Database checkout; the frozen backup reads that checkout. Both conflict with the governing no-clone/no-local-write rule. SA-504 therefore retains the frozen oracle while replacing only its forbidden transport/source with the official clone-free client and its API-acknowledged canonical facts. Existing single-transaction and three-replica completion cores remain intact.

residual_risk_and_non_claims: No real Private-Database, GitHub, R2, OCI, Cloudflare, account, credential, provider request, age binary invocation, ciphertext upload, remote readback/delete, data upload, Docker action, deployment, Git stage/commit/push/merge/rebase, new worktree, or legacy ignored-runtime access occurred.

Fixture PASS proves command ordering, serialization, idempotency, local policy boundaries, and same-cipher receipt handling only. It does not prove the configured client path, gh authentication, Private-Database authorization, repository privacy, R2/OCI bucket policy, free-tier availability, age recipient validity, object persistence, or real remote readback.

A real Owner-authorized encrypted canary remains NOT_RUN and must be explicitly approved with production client/recipient/store configuration. It must remain separate from this local acceptance evidence and may not upload plaintext or expose a private identity.
